summary: NightFood Holdings filed an 8-K reporting unregistered issuance of 1,500,000 shares to Christopher Dieterich, director resignations (Lei Sonny Wang, Thomas Morse) and appointments (Darren Kenney, Ronald J. Stauber). Resignations were not due to disagreements. Shares issued under Section 4(a)(2)/Reg D. The board changes are routine governance moves without disclosed disputes; the share issuance is an ordinary private placement. No special-situation transaction is evident.
